messages.subject: fileInput - how to refresh "file uploaded"
parts:
Is there a way to clear the progress bar after a file has loaded and start over.

Basically reinitialize it to the way it is when the app starts.

I want to load a file, perform a task, load the next file. I seem to be running into trouble. 

One possible bug I notices is if the file name is the same, but actually you made a change and just resaved the file you were trying to upload, shiny won't recognize that.

i tried setting the datapath of the file input to NULL inside an observeEvent but this didn't work

observeEvent(input$REFRESH,{
  
 
  filename$datapath<-NULL
  
})

Thanks
Mike
